image_description: A close-up portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja) facing left. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its wings and chest, a white neck with some pink down, and a long, flat, spatulate bill that is greenish-grey at the base and pale/yellowish at the tip. The background is a blurred natural setting with tree trunks.
